notes.title: Early Access is over now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

what is worth waiting for!
Pharao Reloaded has left Early Access and is now fully published. ːsteamhappyː

To celebrate that with you, the price has been decreased [b]permanently[/b].

Additionally there was another small update:

[list]
[*] 2 new trophies added for completing both tutorials
[*] Multiplayer: shot down skeletons now respawn with a minimum distance to their previous position
[*] Multiplayer: summonded skeletons are no longer brought to the next round
[*] Manuals on shoppage have been updated to current version
[/list]

Thank you very much for your input and all those test sessions. :-)

If you still notice things that could be better or different, I would be happy if you write them in the forum.

Have fun in the depths of the pyramids!
o/

notes.title: Multiplayer mode released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

another coincidence!

Almost two years to the day after I released Pharaoh Reloaded on Steam, I'm proud to release the big multiplayer update today. \o/

So much has happened, but first things first:

[h1]New game mode: Multiplayer![/h1]
[list]
[*]A complete new mode to play, almost a new game
[*]A match can take up to four players
[*]Play a match with multiple rounds. Find as much treasures as you can, shoot the guardians of the pyramid and annoy your friends. The highest score wins!
[/list]
[h1]Tutorials![/h1]
[list]
[*]Learn how to play Singleplayer and Multiplayer mode. It's no longer necessary to read boring manuals. But you still can, if you want ;-)
[*]During the game you can always consult ingame help-dialogs
[/list]
[h1]Music![/h1]
[list]
[*]Rob the pyramids while moody music is playing
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some design-changes were made for players who suffer from red-green color blindness
[*]Title scene now contains selection of Tutorials, Singleplayer or Multiplayer
[*]You can select the classic or classic-plus-experience in the Singleplayer settings now
[*]Rework of the round-won- and game-over-fanfares
[*]The Steam Shoppage got some new content containing of new fancy videos, screenshots and a updated description
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes![/h1]
[list]
[*]Text in highscore now has better contrast
[*]Singleplayer mode: the player was constantly injured in pause mode when hitting by enemy in the moment of pausing
[*]A lot of optimization and minor bugfixes under the hood
[/list]

To celebrate that with you, there's 20´% off until upcoming monday April 25th 2022! ːsteamthumbsupː

Now have fun competing with your friends and maybe we will meet in a pyramid one day. I would be happy ːsteamhappyː

I am already looking forward to your opinion and comments here in the forum. 


o/

notes.title: News from multiplayer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

for a long time it was quiet in the venerable pyramid and one could get the impression that it is slowly but steadily being buried by the sand of eternity. 
But something is happening deep in the catacombs and slowly the secrets are emerging. 

This artifact has been recovered and the hardworking Egyptologists are still busy deciphering the hieroglyphs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37234120/d62e167191fa98a55fe8452e94aec12aa082f0b7.png[/img]

What have they discovered so far?
[list]
[*]Two to four fearless archeologists examine the maze together but also in competition
[*]Unlike the solo adventure there is only one floor to explore
[*]Weapons are dangerous, not only for the guards of the pyramid
[*]Every adventure takes several rounds and time is limited
[/list]
As soon as the explorers have deciphered more of the thousand-year-old texts, they will publish them here.

See you soon

o/

notes.title: Halloween is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Halloween is coming to egypt. ːsteamhappyː

To celebrate that, a brandnew update has been published.

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New enemy for Classic+ mode: Samhain, the ghost of halloween, will visit the ancient pyramids four weeks long starting two weeks before halloween. If you shoot on him, maybe he will drop an additional halloween-treasure.
[*] Especially for that two new Steam achievements have been added
[*] There are also new handmade levels 
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The speed potion now lasts longer
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The player no longer gets hurt if he walks into the cloud of dust of a shoten enemy
[*] Sometimes the player didn't get hurt on acid drops
[*] Protection time of speed potion doesn't stop decreasing while game pauses
[*] Protection time of shield doesn't stop decreasing while game pauses
[/list]

I would enjoy your feedback in the discussion board.

Have a good time :-)

o/

notes.title: New game mode "Classic Plus" is available now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

what a coincidence!
Exactly four weeks after the last minor update I am proud to announce the arrival of the new game mode "Classic Plus" which enhances the existing Classic Mode by the following new features:

[h3]New enemy: Poisoned spiders[/h3]
They walk on the ceiling and sometimes climb down on its thread.

[h3]New potions[/h3]
[h3]Anubis‘ magic potion of speed[/h3]
You speed up on walking and climbing for a short time.

[h3]The protecting elixir of Imhotep[/h3]
You will be invulnerable for a short time.

[h3]More levels[/h3]
[list]
[*]There are breandnew handmade levels and also
[*]an integrated level generator for unlimited variety
[/list]

[h3]An atmospheric background-design[/h3]
If you play in Classic Plus mode, your playfield is surrounded by hieroglyphs of the ancient pyramids. Can you decipher them?
You can have a look on it on the screenshot-section on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270280/Pharao_Reloaded]shop-page[/url].

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Problem with ghost wandering through outer walls 
[*]Rats always starts in the same direction
[*]Some internal optimizations, refactorings and minor bugfixes
[/list]

[h3]Updated Manual[/h3]
All new elements are described in the updated manual [url=https://store.steampowered.com/manual/1270280]here on steam[/url].

Initially it was intended to add new weapons too but this has been deferred to see how the current new features fit in to avoid an overloading or misbalancing. 

But the development of the Classic Plus Mode isn't finished yet. There are a few more things to come I promise ;-)

I am looking forward to your opinion and comments here in the forum.

So have a nice weekend, a beautiful pentecost and of corse a lot of fun with Pharao Reloaded.

o/
